p: were present at that season some: We must not rejoice at the just punishment of others, but rather we should be instructed by it to repent.

Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices: Pontius Pilate was governor of Judea almost ten years, and about the fourth year of his government, which might be about the fifteenth year of Tiberius' reign, Christ finished the work of our redemption by his death.

Siloam fell: That is, in the place, or river: for Siloam was a small river from which the conduits of the city came; see Joh 9:7; Isa 8:6; and therefore it was a tower or a castle, built upon the conduit side, which fell down suddenly and killed some.
He spake also this parable: Great and long suffering is the patience of God, but yet he eventually executes judgment.
cumbereth it the ground: Make the ground barren in that part which is otherwise good for vines.
And he was teaching in one: Christ came to deliver us from the hand of Satan.
spirit of infirmity eighteen years: Troubled with a disease which Satan caused.
loosed from thine infirmity: For Satan had the woman bound, as if she had been in chains, to the extent that for eighteen years time she could not hold up her head.
And the: A graphic image of hypocrisy, and the reward of it.
ruler of the synagogue answered with: One of the rulers of the synagogue, for it appears that there were many rulers of the synagogue, see Mr 5:22 Ac 13:15.
It is like a grain of: God begins his kingdom with small beginnings so that its growth, which is not looked for, may better set forth his power.
And he went through the cities: Against those who had rather err with many than go right with a few, and because of this through their own indifference they are shut out of the kingdom of God.
Then shall ye begin to say: It is vain to be in the Church if one is not of the Church; and whether or not one is in the Church is shown by the purity of life.
There shall be weeping and gnashing: The casting off of the Jews and the calling of the Gentiles is foretold.
east: From all the corners of the world, and the places mentioned here are four of the main ones.
The same day there came certain: We must go forward in regards to our calling, through the midst of terrors, whether they be real or imagined.
fox: That deceitful and treacherous man.

to day and to morrow: That is, a small time, and Theophylact says it is a proverb: or else by "to day" we may understand the present time, and by tomorrow the time to come, meaning by this the entire time of his ministry and office.
perfected: That is, when the sacrifice for sin is finished.

Nevertheless I must walk to day: Nowhere else are there more cruel enemies of the godly than within the sanctuary and Church itself: but God sees it and will in his time have an account for it from them.
brood under her wings: Literally, "the nest": now the brood of chickens is the nest.
